messages.subject: [Seqinr-forum] release 2.0-5
messages.body_plain:
Dear seqinR,

seqinr 2.0-5 is on its way to CRAN. This is a minor release, no
hurry to update.

Best,

Z.


Release Notes for version 2.0-5
-------------------------------

  o  New utility function circle() to draw a circle.

  o  Two more examples of files to be imported with the readBins()
     and readPanels() functions are now available in the abif
     folder: NGM_Bins.txt and NGM_Pa.txt, respectively.

  o  New function plotPanels() to plot amplicon size ranges of STR
     kits data.

  o  New utility function col2alpha() to add a transparency
     chanel to a standard R color.

  o  New ABIF example file samplefsa2ps.fsa used in the
     read.abif() function to reproduce figure 1A from [1].

  o  New function move() aliased as mv() to rename
     an object without deep copy.

  o  New function swap() to exchange two objects.

[1] @article{Krawczyk2009,
author = {Krawczyk, J. and  Goesmann, A. and Nolte, R. and Werber, M.
   and Weisshaar, B.},
title = {{Trace2PS} and {FSA2PS}: two software toolkits for converting
   trace and fsa files to {PostScript} format},
journal = {Source Code for Biology and Medicine},
year = {2009},
volume = {4},
pages = {4} }
